ShaderNodePreset.Description: Six-algorithm dither: Bayer 2x2/4x4/8x8, White Noise, IGN, Error Diffusion. Color or luma mode. Temporal golden ratio animation.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: Dither

Uniform.Tooltip: Dither algorithm. 0=Bayer 2x2, 1=Bayer 4x4, 2=Bayer 8x8, 3=White Noise, 4=IGN (Interleaved Gradient Noise), 5=Error Diffusion (1D approximation).
Uniform.Name: algo

Uniform.Tooltip: Quantization levels. 2 = pure B&W (or primary colours in colour mode). Higher values posterize with intermediate steps.
Uniform.Name: levels

Uniform.Tooltip: Dither amplitude. Scales how much the threshold offsets each quantization step. 0 = no dithering (flat quantize). 1 = standard. >1 = over-dithered / coarser texture.
Uniform.Name: spread

Uniform.Tooltip: Error diffusion only (Algo=5). Number of pixels scanned left and down before the current pixel. Larger windows carry error further.
Uniform.Name: scan_size

Uniform.Tooltip: Colour mode. On = dither each RGB channel independently (colour output). Off = dither BT.709 luminance only (B&W output).
Uniform.Name: color_mode

Uniform.Tooltip: Temporal dithering. Shifts the threshold each frame by the golden ratio (0.618...). Over time the dither pattern integrates to a smooth gradient. Works on all modes except Error Diffusion.
Uniform.Name: temporal

Uniform.Tooltip: Error diffusion only (Algo=5). How much of the quantization error from each pixel propagates to the next. 0 = no propagation (flat quantize). 1 = full carry.
Uniform.Name: error_carry
